questions.question: How did the robotic platform organize and quantify sequential CO₂-reduction experiments?

options.A: One cell body moved across ten cell-pan pairs; a queued run flowed electrolyte, applied voltage, and used online gas chromatography for CO and H₂
options.B: Ten independent cell bodies ran simultaneously and pooled all effluents for offline NMR analysis
options.C: One cell body used a single electrode and manually changed gases between runs, with gravimetric product measurement
options.D: Ten microdroplet cells screened catalysts without quantifying gaseous products

questions.rationale: The setup uses one movable body over ten pans, sequential electrolysis, electrolyte/gas flow, and online GC product detection.
questions.evidence_quote: The overall robot design consists of a single cell body that houses the reference and counter electrodes, complimented by a line of ten cell pan pairs that each house a carbon paper working electrode.

questions.question: What flexibility did the authors emphasize as essential for kinetic-analysis experiments, beyond catalyst-screening automation?

options.A: Each queued run could use a different working electrode, electrolyte, and gas-phase reactant composition
options.B: Every run used a common electrode and fixed electrolyte but independently varied only stirring speed
options.C: Each run could switch temperature but required identical electrodes and gas composition
options.D: The system automatically synthesized a different catalyst in each cell pan

questions.rationale: Testing fresh electrocatalysts across a wide operating-condition range requires changing electrode, electrolyte, and gas composition between individual sequential runs.
questions.evidence_quote: Our robotic system automatically performs queued electrochemical experiments that, unlike previous approaches, can accommodate a different electrode, electrolyte, and gasphase reactant composition for each individual experiment.

questions.question: What limitation arose from using the study's undivided, single-compartment electrochemical cell?

options.A: Counter-electrode oxygen could cross to the working electrode and cause parasitic ORR; average FE closure to CO and H₂ was only about 60%
options.B: The reference electrode could not be calibrated, so all applied potentials were unknown
options.C: A membrane blocked CO₂ transport and prevented measurable CO production
options.D: Pt counter-electrode dissolution increased FE closure above 100%

questions.rationale: Without a membrane, oxygen evolved at the counter electrode can reach the cathode and be reduced; the authors report average CO+H₂ FE of only roughly 60%.
questions.evidence_quote: We did in fact observe incomplete Faradaic efficiency (FE) closure, where across all runs, an average of only c.a. 60% was attributable to CO and H2 formation, and the remaining Faradaic efficiency was presumably lost to oxygen reduction

questions.question: How did automated CoPc rates compare with prior measurements in a conventional three-compartment cell, and what kinetic feature nevertheless agreed?

options.A: CO rates were up to ten times lower, but previously reported kinetic trends were preserved and correlated with the earlier data
options.B: CO rates were ten times higher, and all bicarbonate dependence disappeared
options.C: CO rates matched exactly, but the Tafel trends reversed across the potential window
options.D: No CO was detected, although hydrogen selectivity matched previous work

questions.rationale: The authors observed substantially lower absolute rates and CO FE, yet the measured rates correlated with the prior work and retained the earlier kinetic trends.
questions.evidence_quote: We found that the newly measured rates towards CO production were up to ten times lower than previously reported

questions.question: How did apparent bicarbonate inhibition vary with potential for CoPc/CoTPP compared with FePc?

options.A: For CoPc and CoTPP inhibition was strongest at less reductive potentials and became positive at more reductive potentials; FePc showed stronger inhibition at more reductive potentials
options.B: All three catalysts showed strongest inhibition at more reductive potentials
options.C: CoPc and CoTPP showed no potential dependence, while FePc became bicarbonate-promoted at negative potentials
options.D: CoPc showed positive bicarbonate order throughout, whereas CoTPP and FePc were potential-independent

questions.rationale: The three catalysts separate into two trends: inhibition attenuates with more reductive potential for CoPc/CoTPP but is amplified for FePc.
questions.evidence_quote: For CoPc and CoTPP, the apparent dependence on bicarbonate is most negative at less reductive potentials and becomes positive at more reductive potentials

questions.question: What mechanistic feature did the authors invoke to explain why FePc can show stronger bicarbonate inhibition at more reductive potential despite weaker local bicarbonate adsorption?

options.A: A most-abundant reactive intermediate before the unoccupied site can be depleted more strongly with potential, increasing overall poisoned-site coverage
options.B: Potential-independent electrolyte poisoning eliminates the unoccupied catalyst site at all voltages
options.C: The local bicarbonate adsorption equilibrium becomes more favorable at increasingly negative potential
options.D: The FePc catalyst changes into CoPc through metal crossover at negative potential

questions.rationale: The proposed FePc model places the MARI before the free site; its potential-dependent conversion can raise the population of bicarbonate-poisoned sites even while the local adsorption ratio falls.
questions.evidence_quote: Here, the conversion of the MARI (θA, yellow) to the unoccupied site has a stronger voltage dependence than the bicarbonate electrosorption equilibrium.

questions.question: Which catalyst showed a near-ideal first-order CO₂ dependence, and which showed saturation-like attenuation?

options.A: CoPc was close to first order; CoTPP was slightly sub-first-order and became more attenuated at more reductive potential
options.B: CoTPP was exactly first order; CoPc showed strong saturation at all potentials
options.C: FePc was exactly first order; CoTPP showed a superlinear CO₂ order
options.D: All three catalysts showed identical first-order dependence independent of potential

questions.rationale: The CO₂-order analysis describes CoPc as apparently ideal and CoTPP as slightly below one, with further attenuation as potential becomes more reductive.
questions.evidence_quote: For CoPc, the CO2 order dependence appears quite ideal, where a simple first order dependence is within error for both potentials shown

questions.question: What unusual potential-dependent CO₂-order behavior was reported for FePc?

options.A: The order was more attenuated at less reductive potentials, and the curves intersected so voltage inhibited reaction at low CO₂ pressure
options.B: The order was more attenuated at more reductive potentials, with no intersection at any pressure
options.C: The order was fixed at one and voltage promoted reaction at all CO₂ pressures
options.D: The reaction rate was independent of CO₂ pressure at both potentials

questions.rationale: FePc exhibited intersecting CO₂-dependence curves; the model interprets the low-pressure region as voltage directing flux into an unproductive intermediate.
questions.evidence_quote: Additionally, the CO2 order dependence curves for the two different potentials intersect, meaning that at low CO2 partial pressures, voltage inhibits the reaction.

questions.question: What interpretation did the authors give for the particularly high HER Faradaic efficiencies observed in their setup?

options.A: Pt crossover could create adventitious HER sites, but low coverage molecular tetrapyrrole sites should preserve the kinetic interpretation of partial CO current
options.B: CoPc catalyzed HER exclusively, so CO current could not be attributed to tetrapyrrole sites
options.C: The high HER FE proved that gas chromatography underestimated CO production by exactly 60%
options.D: The Pt counter electrode suppressed HER but increased oxygen evolution at the working electrode

questions.rationale: The study notes typical HER FE of 30–60% and possible Pt deposition/crossover, while arguing this should minimally affect CO kinetics on sparsely distributed molecular catalyst sites.
questions.evidence_quote: We did in fact observe relatively high FEs toward HER, typically around 30 to 60%

questions.question: What did the authors explicitly refrain from claiming about their mechanistic models?

options.A: The conceptual models capture kinetic trends qualitatively but were not quantitatively fit to all data using statistical goodness-of-fit metrics
options.B: The models prove a single elementary mechanism shared by all three catalysts
options.C: The models quantitatively predict every current without any free parameters
options.D: The models exclude catalyst poisoning and mixed control as possible explanations

questions.rationale: The paper stresses that its models are conceptual explanations of observed signatures, not statistically validated full fits that establish a unique mechanism.
questions.evidence_quote: those mechanisms only qualitatively capture the observed trends, but do not quantitatively, via statistical goodness-of-fit metrics, fit all of the experimental data.
